clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Eitrigg stands beside Warchief Thrall as a trusted advisor. A veteran of the First and Second Wars, he left the Blackrock clan’s Horde after its defeat and lived in exile. Now he helps Thrall guide the New Horde toward honor and shamanism.

Born on Draenor among the Blackrock clan, Eitrigg fought for the Horde in the First and Second Wars. The battles and the Horde’s defeat in the second war forced him to face how far his people had fallen into bloodlust and demonic corruption. Sickened by what the Horde had become, he left its scattered remnants and sought solitude in the wilds of Lordaeron.

During his exile, Eitrigg sheltered in an abandoned tower near Hearthglen. The human paladin Tirion Fordring found him, and their clash brought the tower’s ruins down around them. Eitrigg pulled the unconscious human to safety instead of finishing him. Moved by this act of martial honor, Tirion swore friendship and kept the hermit’s location secret. The local Alliance authorities eventually captured Eitrigg and sentenced him to hang in Stratholme. Tirion cast aside his knighthood, lands, and freedom to attack the city and rescue him. Their bond showed both warriors that honor could cross the hatred between their peoples.

In Stratholme, Thrall’s newly united Horde raided the city during Tirion’s attempt to free Eitrigg and carried the aging warrior away. Meeting Thrall convinced Eitrigg that the orcs were casting off demonic corruption and returning to their ancestral shamanic heritage. He crossed the Great Sea with Thrall to Kalimdor and took a revered place in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Wisdom. Now Eitrigg advises the young Warchief inside Grommash Hold. He helps evaluate new recruits and shares the wisdom he earned, so the New Horde does not repeat the tragedies of the past.
